title: Test stack: the seeded platform admin appeared as admin@admin.com instead of super@admin.com, so the e2e login failed with 401
summary: On 2026-11-15, after a PC restart and a no-cache rebuild of the backend image, a freshly reset e2e stack logged 'Provisioned platform admin super@admin.com (1)' but the database held user 1 as admin@admin.com and super@admin.com could not log in (401). admin@admin.com and petra@admin.com logged in with 123456. The cause is not found (no HRMS was running). The e2e scripts now read E2E_USER (stack.mjs and api.ts), so the stack can be used with E2E_USER=admin@admin.com.
steps: Reset the e2e stack (pnpm e2e:reset, full mode).
expected: The platform admin from application-dev.properties (super@admin.com) can log in.
where: Backend: AdminBootstrapSeeder / AdminBootstrapHrmsLinker (the linker logs 'Linked platform admin ... to HRMS employee 1'). e2e: e2e/stack/stack.mjs, e2e/support/api.ts.
verify: After a reset, login with super@admin.com works, or the e2e docs say which email the seed produces.
status_evidence: Seen 2026-11-15 on release_beta_1.0.0 and backend deployment/dev@b2597ef11; worked on 2026-11-14 with the same code.
